rubric.summary: Score = size fit (0-2.5) + industry fit (0-2.5) + source intent (0-3) + recency (0-2), max 10. >= 7.5 qualified, < 6.5 rejected, in between = human review. Knockouts: < 10 employees or no contact in > 365 days. Missing fields are scored as a range; if the range straddles a threshold the lead goes to review. AI red flags can move a qualified lead to review but never qualify or reject on their own.
